messages:
samir: Heads-up — customer #452 reporting big p99 latency spike after we pushed a new int8 calibration profile last night. Baseline (fp16): p50 40ms / p95 180ms / p99 420ms. After int8 calib: p50 38ms / p95 250ms / p99 980ms. Route: /v1/generate model:redwood-large-2025 quant_profile:int8-calib, region:us-west1.

jessica: Ugh. Any error traces or specific requests that reproduce? Is it all shapes or long context cases?

samir: Repro is pretty consistent with medium-length prompts (tokens ~350). Quick curl we used to repro:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-2025","input":"<PROMPT>...","max_tokens":512,"quant_profile":"int8-calib"}'
```
Request ID: req_0a7f4e3b. I attached the per-request trace lines below (stack-trace style snippets):
```
[worker-12] kvcache: warm_miss seq=350 cfg=int8-calib
[worker-12] kernel_select: chosen=matmul_fused_opt_v2
[worker-12] dispatch: quant-path fallback_check latency=760ms
[worker-12] rpc: send -> router timeout=300s
```

jessica: Hmm looks like a runtime fallback path kicking in mid-inference (dispatch: quant-path fallback_check). Could be a kernel mismatch for certain seq lengths with int8. Did the calibration change the tile sizes?

samir: Calibration adjusted per-layer scales and enabled per-channel qparams. I can repro with an internal flag: `RDW_QUANT_DEBUG=1` which adds verbose logs — more lines: `quantizer: per_channel enabled, fallback_threshold=0.12` then those fallback-check latencies.

taylor: For immediate mitigation we can toggle runtime fallback to fp16 for that route while we investigate. Two options: (1) set route override to `quant_profile: fp16` (fast, full rollback) or (2) set `fallback_to_fp16: true` so int8 stays but will drop to fp16 during fallback at kernel selection. I recommend option 2 as a softer rollback.

ingrid: Agree, do the softer rollback first. Also create a 5% canary that uses a modified quant profile with relaxed per_channel (disable per-channel) and see if p99 improves. We'll need metrics dashboard showing p50/p95/p99 and error/rate.

samir: Applying fallback flag now via admin API:
```bash
curl -sS -X PATCH https://admin.redwood.com/v1/routes/452/config \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"overrides": {"fallback_to_fp16": true}}'
```
Response: 200 OK, change_id=chg_9f1b2.

deploy-bot: deploy chg_9f1b2 scheduled and rolled to 100% on route 452 (instant config) :white_check_mark:

samir: Ran a batch of repro requests immediately after change. New numbers: p50 39ms / p95 185ms / p99 430ms. Looks like fallback_to_fp16 fixed the tail.

jessica: Nice. Next steps: (A) Roll a small canary with modified int8 profile that disables per-channel quant, (B) run calibration a/b tests measuring p99 and generation-quality (use eval set), (C) add a kernel-compatibility check to preflight calibration to detect sequences that would trigger fallback.

taylor: I can own the canary and preflight check. Plan: create a canary config `int8-canary-no-perchannel` with 5% traffic and run 1h synthetic and customer replay tests. If p99 < 500ms and quality delta < 1% on eval, we can promote.

ingrid: Also add an alert rule: if quant_path_fallback_rate > 0.5% AND p99 > baseline*1.8, open a P1 and auto-enable `fallback_to_fp16` for affected routes. That'll avoid future silent regressions.

samir: Documenting repro steps and logs in the ticket. I'm uploading sample request/response bodies and the RDW_QUANT_DEBUG dump. Will follow up with canary results.

jessica: Thanks. One more ask for the customer-facing reply: prepare a short note explaining we detected a quantization kernel fallback that impacted tail latency after the calibration change, we temporarily enabled safe fp16 fallback while we validate a refined int8 profile, and we'll share canary results + ETA. Keep it simple. :ok_hand:

samir: Drafted reply and put in ticket for review. Action items: samir (upload logs + customer note), taylor (create canary + preflight), ingrid (alert rule + playbook), jessica (approve customer note).

taylor: Start canary now, I'll post results in ~45m.

samir: Thanks all. Repro artifacts: https://internal.redwood.com/tickets/452/artifacts/quant-debug-req_0a7f4e3b.txt

deploy-bot: canary int8-canary-no-perchannel created (route 452, 5% traffic) — monitoring enabled.
